slides.title: Start *smaller* than feels useful.
slides.sub: Big plans feel good. Small ones get done.

slides.title: Big starts need big days.
slides.body: A plan that only works on your best day will stall on your ordinary ones. Most days are ordinary.

slides.title: Shrink it until it's almost silly.
slides.body: Not "have the hard talk." Write the first sentence you'd say. Not "journal every day." One line.

slides.title: Test it on a bad day.
slides.body: If you can do it tired, busy and annoyed, it's the right size. You can always do more.
